facts.business: Smruthi Organics Ltd manufactures Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API) and formulations, with an in-house R&D plant.
key_risks: Inventory valuation risk due to significant judgement in overhead allocation and net realizable value assessment
Customer concentration risk with 3 major customers accounting for over 10% of sales each
Regulatory compliance risk under Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 and Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985
Delay in regulatory filings (one day delay in Annual Report submission to BSE)
facts.related_party_note: No loans or advances granted to promoters, directors, KMPs, or related parties. No transactions with companies struck off under Companies Act.
